items.Sentence: The system consists of a 12-acre facultative pond Primary and equipped with floating aerators. The pond depth is estimated to be 10 feet and has a capacity of 30 million gallons.

The headworks consist of two lift stations (Lift Station 1 Headworks/Preliminary and Lift Station 3). The stations do not have any influent Treatment screening. Manual maintenance is performed to remove large debris from the suction side of influent pumps.

Solids accumulated in the treatment pond are removed by dredging and disposed of at a nearby municipal landfill facility as needed. The ultimate destination of biosolids produced is Monterey Regional Waste Management District - Landfill Facility located at 14201 Del Monte Boulevard in Marina California.
